Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo, looking at a big Greek-mythology chess set with white stone walls around the board: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Quick comic timing. Clear, well-articulated words. First line: lost and puzzled, following the walls with his finger, looking for the way out. Second line: amazed and delighted.

Mago.style: El Mago, a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm voice and a playful smile, showing a chess set from ancient Greece. First line: dramatic and grand, like a storyteller announcing a fight. Second line: completely deadpan and dry. Third line: proud, saying the numbers slowly and clearly. Last line: warm and inviting, straight to the viewer.
lines: Es un ajedrez. Se sale ganando.
Y este trae su tablero: cincuenta y dos por cincuenta.
Comentá minotauro y te paso precio y fecha.
